title: SG-10.1 Keyboard handling in the Phaser scene with typed events
summary: Tab/arrows move focus, Enter/Space select, Escape closes the menu, via typed events
description: Context: SceneObject already has focus(), blur() and handleKey(), and buildScene.ts exports moveFocus(), but BootScene never listens to the keyboard. Desired behavior: Tab and arrow keys move focus between visible interactive objects, Enter or Space selects the focused object and opens its action menu, and Escape closes the menu. All of it is emitted as typed events on the Phaser to React bus. Why: interactive objects must be keyboard-accessible.
acceptance_criteria: Given a scene with visible objects, when Tab or ArrowRight/ArrowDown is pressed, then focus moves forward and a typed focusChange event is emitted with the focused object id.
Given a focused object, when Enter or Space is pressed, then objectClick is emitted with that object id and the ActionMenu opens.
Given an open ActionMenu, when Escape is pressed, then a typed menuClose event is emitted and the menu closes.
Each key has a mocked unit test, and Phaser is mocked.

out_of_scope: Changes to the SceneObject or moveFocus logic

definition_of_done: All three requirements are implemented and verified by unit tests
non_functional: Listeners are removed on scene shutdown
